items.title: Wall Street May Be Sleeping on This Massive AI CPU Opportunity
items.summary: Arm has quietly captured the CPU backbone of the AI data center buildout, yet its current price tells a strikingly different story than its growth numbers do. Here is what Wall Street keeps missing.

items.title: The TPU Mix Is Thinning Broadcom's Gross Margin, Not Its Profit
items.summary: The mix shift toward custom AI silicon is pulling Broadcom's gross margin lower while its operating margin has gone the other way, and that gap is the case for the stock.

items.title: Intel Stock Is Paying Now For Revenue Due Later
items.summary: Intel's capital spending keeps climbing while outside customers still contribute almost none of the foundry's revenue, and that gap is the main risk in the stock.

items.title: The Floor Under Micron's Worst Case Is Written Into Its Contracts, Not Memory Prices
items.summary: The take-or-pay agreements that bears read as a cap on upside are the same ones that put a priced floor under Micron's worst case.

items.title: Qualcomm vs. Sandisk: Comparing Gradual Revenue Contraction Against Rapid Revenue Acceleration
items.summary: Qualcomm's revenue has declined over two years while Sandisk's surged nearly 5x, narrowing a once-massive gap.

items.title: How Is QUALCOMM's Stock Performance Compared to Other Semiconductor Stocks?
items.summary: Despite QUALCOMM's underperformance relative to its industry peers over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a moderately optimistic outlook on the stock’s prospects.

items.title: SCHD Is Up Nearly 30% and Its Yield Is Back Near 3% | Did Dividend Investors Miss the Easy Money?
items.summary: SCHD just delivered a return most dividend investors spend a decade waiting for, and that success created a problem nobody predicted. Whether fresh money belongs in the fund right now depends on a tradeoff that long-term holders never had to face.
